description: Catalog of known Antfarm failure patterns for medic diagnostics.

diagnostic_predicate_schema.type: Mechanical check type: sql | json_path | cmd | substring
diagnostic_predicate_schema.query: Predicate body — SQL for sql, JSONPath-like dot path for json_path, shell command for cmd, literal substring for substring
diagnostic_predicate_schema.notes: Human documentation when no mechanical check applies

modes.summary: Step stuck in running after agent timeout or crash
modes.diagnostic_check: Steps in status running longer than max role timeout

diagnostic_predicate.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM steps s JOIN runs r ON r.id = s.run_id WHERE s.status = 'running' AND r.status = 'running'

modes.summary: Run marked running but all steps are terminal
modes.diagnostic_check: Runs with status running and no waiting/pending/running steps

diagnostic_predicate.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM runs r WHERE r.status = 'running' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM steps s WHERE s.run_id = r.id AND s.status IN ('waiting','pending','running'))

modes.summary: Agent crons still running with no active workflow runs
modes.diagnostic_check: Antfarm cron jobs exist while workflow has zero running runs

diagnostic_predicate.notes: Evaluated by medic via gateway cron list + DB cross-check (checkOrphanedCrons)

modes.summary: Installed agent cron prompt is stale — missing current two-phase polling markers
modes.diagnostic_check: Cron payload message must contain sessions_spawn and must NOT instruct sessions_yield (removed in current buildPollingPrompt)

modes.summary: Live agent workspace files differ from bundled workflow source
modes.diagnostic_check: Run antfarm workflow check-drift <id> — nonzero exit means drift

diagnostic_predicate.notes: Workflow id parameterized at runtime by medic; documented-only default names thecoach-dev

modes.summary: Two runs operating on the same REPO checkout concurrently
modes.diagnostic_check: Multiple running runs whose context.repo or task REPO: line resolve to the same path

diagnostic_predicate.query: SELECT context FROM runs WHERE status = 'running'
diagnostic_predicate.notes: Requires parsing JSON context in application code — not expressible as a single SQL predicate; guarded at runWorkflow startup instead
